skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK damage to a single target in 3 consecutive hits.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc:
Deals 9000% [Specialized Direct DMG] to the entire target's column in a 5-hit combo.

After releasing the skill, unleashes a 5-hit combo of [Dual Extreme Kill Formation] on a random row, dealing 11000% [Specialized Direct DMG].

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc:
Battle start, gains 80% [85%] [90%] [Specialized Non-Crit DMG Reduction].

Grants allied monster characters a permanent 45% [50%] [55%] [Block Rate] upon entering the battlefield.

Removes [Energy Shield] and [Base HP Increase] effects from all enemies upon entering the battlefield.

skills.name: Awakened Passive
skills.desc:
Upon entering the field, grants permanent [Protection] buff to self and all monster characters in the same row.

The [Protection] effect increases by 1x each turn when the character uses a skill, up to a maximum of 3x.

Protection healing and additional-damage definition: PENDING subject and source reconciliation. Do not assume every effect is tripled.
